thread:
matt: deploy-bot just flagged a canary regression on embeddings-route — p95 latency jumped ~3x and error-rate doubled. deploy-bot suggests auto-rollback to v3.9.1. change window closes 03:00 UTC. requesting manual hold + rollback authorization.
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary: embeddings-route p95=1240ms (baseline 420ms), errors 2.1% -> 4.6%. autorevert candidate: v3.9.1. logs: https://logs.redwood.example/canary/3331
sara: ugh. do we know if it's kvcache-related or an infra flare? any correlated OOMs?
matt: quick grep shows increased KV eviction on hosts gpu-emb-12, no OOMs. kernel flags look normal. could be model change pathing.
oliver: if deploy-bot already wants auto-rollback I'd vote let it. but manual confirm good because EU dedicated customers on running migration.
jen: +1 manual hold. if we rollback we need a customer blurb and legal loop if any contracts in maintenance window. product-ops can draft message.
product-ops: I'll draft. target: short customer note about transient degradation and rollback to prior version; no data loss. pinging CSMs.
oncall-ops: FYI change window is 02:00-04:00 UTC, traffic slice still 10% canary. rolling back now would keep impact small. need operator to run revert command and monitor kvcache warm-up.
matt: ok assigning @oliver as operator. oliver can you run revert? command below.
oliver: on it. running in 2m.
oliver: running: ```/release revert --service embeddings-route --to v3.9.1 --strategy rolling --slice 10 --reason "canary regression"``` 
oliver: hitting step 2/5: drain canary instances.
matt: disable autoscaler on the canary pool while we revert: `infractl autoscale set embeddings-canary --min 0 --max 0` then re-enable after.
oliver: done with drain and revert triggered. logs show rollout started. monitoring telemetry.
deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback rollout started by oliver. rollback progress: 20% -> 60% -> 100%.
jen: drafting release notes snippet: "Transient canary regression detected; automated system recommended rollback; manual authorization executed; rolling back to v3.9.1; monitoring ongoing." Will push to docs after ops confirm.
sara: telemetry now p95=430ms, errors 1.9%. looks like rollback restored baseline.
oncall-ops: please run quick smoke: `curl -sS https://embeddings.int/api/health | jq .latency_p95` and paste
oliver: smoke: 420ms, 0.8% errors on canary slice.
matt: good. re-enable autoscale: `infractl autoscale set embeddings-canary --min 1 --max 8`
oliver: autoscaler re-enabled. kvcache warming: keys ~90% warmed after 8 minutes.
product-ops: customer blurb ready, sending to CSMs: "We observed a transient performance regression in our latest canary, have rolled back to v3.9.1. No customer data was impacted. We will follow up with root cause." (sending now)
jen: legal loop: no contractual SLA breach expected, but I'll file an incident note and keep legal copied.
matt: final ops checklist: 1) confirm release notes updated (jen) 2) ticket + RCA follow-up (sara) 3) monitor for 2h (oncall-ops). who owns RCA?
sara: I'll own RCA, will pull canary snapshots, kernel traces, and KV eviction stats. target doc by EOD.
oncall-ops: monitoring for 2h, alerts re-armed. set temporary alert threshold tighter for p95.
matt: thanks all. rollback complete, canary stable, customers notified. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
